_README: GENERATED by tools/spoils-to-changes.py from Reputation-Matrix2/data/inventory.json — re-run the tool, do not edit.
Items the archive's registry says a party character holds and the exported sheet does not carry.
tools/sheets-suite.py regenerates and applies this on every pass; by hand:
Items are matched by id (flags.waluipedia.inventoryItem), so re-applying is a no-op.
`filed` remembers when each item first came through; `declined` lists items the table removed after seeing
them (delete a row to offer it again). Nothing here touches XP — tools/promote-player-sheets.py pins that to the ledger.

A pair of Iron Legion handcuffs put on Waluigi by the Colour Division on the upper landing of the Overgrown Manor when he and Toad Lee were taken as leverage against Hjumpik’s overdue Aegis Magi contract (2 Aethel, 922 BF, Feyward clock). Waluigi slipped them immediately and stood there wearing them anyway, because there is no theatre in an empty cuff.

  • Cuffs rather than mage cages — Hjumpik’s condition, accepted without argument, which worried Waluigi more than a refusal would have.
  • Slipped at once; worn by choice for the theatre of it.
  • Still on Waluigi’s wrists, open, at the end of the session; the Division has not noticed.

Obtained: Produced by Red after Hjumpik put a hand on his warhammer and said ‘No cages. They’re not animals. Just hold them.’ The Division agreed without argument.

On the record: slipped at once; worn by choice.
